name: ict-club-management-system
description: ICT Club Management System for secondary schools - students, executive committee, club dues, meetings, activities, courses, attendance, reports, certificates, notes and projects.

scripts.setup: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test:all
